target_customer: Workers' compensation claims teams (carriers, TPAs, employers) and physicians who prepare IME, QME and AME med-legal reports
problem: Workers' compensation cases stall because evaluators and adjusters must read thousands of pages of medical records by hand to build chronologies and draft reports.
business_model: B2B software and services for med-legal evaluations, pricing not public
product_category: AI medical record review and med-legal report drafting

founders.name: Akhil Sachdev
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists only him and gives no background. A secondary directory says some founder background claims could not be confirmed, so none are recorded.

competitors.name: Wisedocs
competitors.what: AI claims document and medical record review, including California QME use cases
competitors.traction_then: Customers such as KEMI; shipped WiseChat and custom reports

competitors.name: Quench
competitors.what: Gen AI medico-legal records review for lawyers, expert witnesses and independent medical examiners

technical_complexity.rationale: Long-document extraction and summarization of messy medical records is standard LLM engineering, but accuracy, HIPAA compliance and report formats for QME and IME work add hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals sell similar record review, and a three person team has no cited proprietary data. Workflow integration with evaluators could create some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known as of late 2026; no acquisition or copying reported in sources.

market_need_then: Workers' compensation evaluators handle very large record sets and report backlogs delay settlements. Generative AI made automated chronology building feasible by 2025, and several vendors launched in 2024 and 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses docurahealth.com, health suffix added to the name; no purchase story found

identity.visual_style: Plain enterprise software site stressing HIPAA and security
identity.voice_and_tone: Professional and cautious, 'built to support professional judgment, not replace it'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, no community or merch found; only directory listings and the YC badge.

outcome_analysis: Docura Health is a Winter 2026 YC company with a team of three and no reported exit, layoffs or shutdown. It entered a space where Wisedocs and Quench already sold AI medical record review, so its odds depend on execution and on winning evaluators as customers. Too early for a verdict.
notes: Unverified: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with YC as investor; single aggregator, probably the standard YC deal, so not recorded as a round. No Form D or press release found. Team size shown as 1 or 3 in different sources; YC says 3. Founded year not stated.
